hierarchy.metric_large: text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold font-mono tracking-tighter text-silver

backgrounds.page: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#050505] via-[#0A1128]/50 to-[#050505] min-h-screen text-[#E2E8F0]

visual_enhancers.inner_dark_panel: Inside the cards (e.g., around charts or metric groups), use `bg-[#050505]/70 rounded-lg p-4 shadow-inner border border-[#8C92AC]/10` to create a deep, recessed data area.

card_anatomy.container: relative flex flex-col rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#0A1128]/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#8C92AC]/20 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#E2E8F0]/30 hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(10,17,40,0.9)] group
card_anatomy.top_accent_bar: absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[3px] opacity-80 bg-gradient-to-r to-transparent
card_anatomy.header_row: flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-[#8C92AC]/10 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#8C92AC]/5 to-transparent
card_anatomy.header_title: text-xs font-semibold tracking-widest uppercase text-matte-grey group-hover:text-silver transition-colors
card_anatomy.body: flex-1 p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 relative z-10
card_anatomy.footer: p-4 border-t border-[#8C92AC]/10 bg-[#050505]/40 text-xs text-matte-grey flex items-center justify-between

grid_system.kpi_top_row: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4 mb-8

motion.hover_states: Cards subtly lift (`-translate-y-1`) with increased border brightness. Icons and titles transition from matte-grey to silver.
motion.energy_flow_particles: SVG paths MUST use `stroke-dasharray` and CSS animations (`@keyframes flow`) to animate glowing particles along the lines. Speeds should map to energy volume.
motion.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out` universally for interactive feedback (buttons, cards, badges).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure silver/white text on black/midnight blue backgrounds meets at least 4.5:1 contrast. Neon semantic colors should primarily be used for data plotting, glows, and accents, not small text.
accessibility.data_testid: Add descriptive data-testid attributes to all KPI cards, chart containers, and status badges (e.g., `data-testid="kpi-card-pv-total"`).
accessibility.focus: Focus rings on interactive elements should use `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8C92AC]/50 focus:outline-none rounded-md`.

components.name: GlassCard
components.instructions: Standardize using the `card_anatomy` structure. EVERY card in the dashboard must use this identical container layout. The 3px top border gradient should adopt the semantic color (yellow/red/green/cyan) if the card represents a specific energy domain.

components.name: MetricBig
components.instructions: Use JetBrains Mono. Maintain exact values and labels without modification. Apply targeted drop-shadow (glow) to the text or its icon based on the metric type.

components.name: Sparkline
components.instructions: Wrap in the `inner_dark_panel` style (`bg-[#050505]/70`). Minimalist axes. Stroke color matches semantic neon color. Fill uses a subtle linear gradient fading into the dark panel.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.instructions: Small pill shape (`rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider`). Dark inner background (`bg-[#050505]/80`), glowing 1px border matching status color, and a pulsing dot.

components.name: EnergyFlowDiagram
components.instructions: Central visual piece. Use distinct nodes (PV, Grid, Battery, Home) with glassmorphism styling. Connect them with animated SVG lines featuring the target glow effects. Ensure particles flow in the correct direction (e.g., Grid -> Home or Home -> Grid).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: HARD CONSTRAINT: NEVER alter the displayed data values, labels, or underlying logic. Purely a visual and layout upgrade.
All cards MUST follow the exact same unified anatomy (Header row with icon+title+badge, Body, optional Footer). No exceptions. This ensures visual harmony.
Enforce the new dark sci-fi color palette: Base elements use Black and Midnight Blue, structural elements use Matte Grey, text primarily uses Silver.
Use a darkened background (`bg-[#050505]/70`) INSIDE the tiles for charts, metric groups, or tables. This 'nested depth' is critical to the sci-fi aesthetic.
Do not use generic centered layouts for data. Align text/labels to the left, and numerical values/badges to the right.
Avoid fully transparent overlays or backgrounds over the page background. Always use `backdrop-blur` combined with a semi-transparent color (e.g., `bg-[#0A1128]/40`).
Apply 'data-testid' to all key elements for testing stability.
Ensure the fonts (Chakra Petch, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) are imported and applied correctly according to the typography hierarchy.
